summary: KEEP. Acceptance ① (O-GATE predicate requires Activated): the predicate refuses every NotActivated shape — missing report, SafeDisabled, Unsupported, foreign boot, even Activated-without-probes — and the P24B capability predicate mirrors it, so SafeDisabled never counts as Activated anywhere the gate can reach. Acceptance ② (faults preserve quarantine/one resume): the six fault points each surface, retry succeeds, and the state machine refuses skips and repeats (persist/resume twice = InvalidState; one operation id never carries two trees — the durable single resume). Acceptance ③ (report contains no secrets): the gate's emitted report is redacted (40+-char blobs and credential-shaped key=value, including spaced forms, stripped — the spaced form was caught by the test and hardened), and the digest excludes wall-clock so regeneration is deterministic. P31.1 (ownership/resume/output/cancel/proof/activation/effects/shell/gix — via the 14-suite corpus), P31.2 (zero bypasses — the launch-boundary guard runs inside the gate), P31.3 (per-target exact digests), P31.4 (legacy recovery composition — same-boot refusal and RebootProof clearing live in s01/s11R, pinned here at the composition boundary: clean recovery, empty grants) all proven. First host execution: 16/19 activated, 3 native-only honestly separated. Disclosed: native-only targets never fail the gate (P32 owns the installed-layout probe policy); the gate composes rather than re-tests.
